row:
Welcome to the channel of Bellamy -- the 29yo flying veteran.

Bellamy is a 29yo Connemara cross still loving life and living it to the max! 

This channel is all about us and our adventures through life. Bellamy is an all rounder dipping his toes into the worlds of dressage, showing, eventing, show jumping and even fancy dress! 

We have a very varied activity schedule and you will find everything here from finding a show to suit your horse, to plaiting tips to one day event vlogs. 

He adores jumping - me less so! 

But we both hope you enjoy coming along with us on our many and varied travels.

I hope you enjoy.
